lines.en: label nikilovesyou2:
scene memorylane1
: {i}Do{/i} you have anything to do with it? Because it seems to me like you keep selecting other heroines instead.
lines.zh: : 这跟你有什么关系吗？因为在我看来，你一直在选别的女主角而不{i}是{/i}我。

lines.en: : Who knew the woes of the childhood friend route applied to real life as well?
lines.zh: : 谁知道青梅竹马路线的悲哀在现实里也一样适用呢？

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound like a certain Irish girl I know and I can’t say I’m a fan of it.
lines.zh: : 你说话的口气开始有点像我认识的某个爱尔兰女孩了，我可说不上喜欢。

lines.en: : Just remember that if you {i}do{/i} continue rejecting my advances, there is an entire Facebook group of people willing to sleep with me. And most of them would probably pay.
lines.zh: : 你只要记住，要是你继续拒绝我的示好，可是有一整个 Facebook 群组的人排着队{i}想{/i}跟我上床。而且他们大多数大概还愿意付钱。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} get the first-love discount. That’s a once in a lifetime promotion, you know.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}现在享受的是初恋折扣。这可是一辈子只有一次的优惠，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Oh, I know. And I’ll be sure to capitalize on it once everything surrounding our relationship stops being so damn depressing.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。等我们这段关系周围的一切不再那么该死的压抑之后，我一定会好好利用它的。

lines.en: scene memorylane2
: Ugh. I really am going to make it to thirty after all.
lines.zh: : 唉。看来我是真的要一路活到三十岁了。

lines.en: Another bout of a certain brand of silence, one that I am beginning to recognize like the back of my hand, carries across the outstretched horizon before planting itself firmly in my lap.
lines.zh: 又一阵某种熟悉的沉默——熟悉到我开始像熟悉自己的手背一样认得出它——掠过延展的地平线，然后稳稳地落在我的膝头。

lines.en: It curls up into a ball of intangible warmth and fills me with a dreadful nostalgia that I attempt to wish away by focusing on the head resting upon my shoulder.
lines.zh: 它蜷成一团无形的温暖，让我心里涨满一种可怕的怀旧；我试图把这份情绪赶走，于是把注意力集中在靠在我肩上的那颗脑袋上。

lines.en: I wonder if this warmth has invaded her as well — and if the thoughts inside her head at this very moment add up to more than just “I’m happy here.”
lines.zh: 我不知道这份温暖是不是也侵入了她——也不知道此刻她脑子里那些念头加起来，是否不止于一句“我在这里很开心”。

lines.en: Are you?
lines.zh: 你开心吗？

lines.en: Happiness is tricky — confusing. And people like me who have grown so disenchanted by the pursuit of it approach the word with extreme caution so as to not {i}think{/i} we’re happy when we’re not.
lines.zh: 幸福是件棘手的事——让人困惑。像我这样早已对追逐幸福幻灭的人，会极其谨慎地对待这个词，生怕在不幸福的时候误{i}以为{/i}自己幸福。

lines.en: So many good things have happened to me lately.
lines.zh: 最近发生了太多好事。

lines.en: And if that is any indication of what is yet to come, I’d be a fool to not admit I’m terrified as there must always be a balance.
lines.zh: 如果这预示着接下来还会发生什么，那我要是不承认自己很害怕，就是个傻子——因为万事总要维持平衡。

lines.en: What goes up must always come down —but that comes with a caveat.
lines.zh: 升上去的东西总要落下来——不过这里有个附加条件。

lines.en: There are things you’ll see and experience in life that will push you further down into the bottomless pit of existence than you’d ever fall on your own.
lines.zh: 人生中有些你会看见、会经历的东西，会把你推入存在的无底洞，推得比你独自坠落时还要深。

lines.en: And while there may be people who notice you screaming and begging for help — who take it upon themselves to lend you a hand and attempt to pull you up, no one will ever pull you {i}out.{/i}
lines.zh: 也许会有人听见你尖叫求救——他们主动伸出手，试图把你拉上去，但没有人会真的把你{i}拉出来{/i}。

lines.en: In the end, you either drag them down with you or let go and hope they never meet the same fate.
lines.zh: 到最后，你要么把他们一起拖下去，要么松手，祈祷他们永远不会落得同样的下场。

lines.en: It will always be easier to fall than it will be to climb.
lines.zh: 坠落永远比攀爬容易。

lines.en: And when you’ve fallen as deep as I have, the last thing you possess is the willpower to fight back against fate.
lines.zh: 而当你像我一样坠得那么深，你身上最后剩下的东西，就是与命运抗争的意志力了。

lines.en: So you fall...and fall...and fall forever-
lines.zh: 于是你坠落……再坠落……永远地坠落下去——

lines.en: : I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我好爱你。

lines.en: And pray that the slowly vanishing light at the top of the well never fully disappears.
lines.zh: 然后祈祷井口那渐渐消逝的光永远不要彻底消失。

lines.en: : I...love you too, Niki.
lines.zh: : 我也……爱你，Niki。

lines.en: : Thanks for trying to pull me out of my bottomless pit.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你试着把我从无底洞里拉出来。

lines.en: scene memorylane3
: It’s that or I jump in there with you. Better to suffer together than to suffer alone, right?
lines.zh: : 不然我也只能跟着跳进去陪你。一起受苦总好过一个人受苦，对吧？

lines.en: : You don’t deserve to suffer.
lines.zh: : 你不该受这种苦。

lines.en: : Neither do you.
lines.zh: : 你也不该。

lines.en: : I do, though. I’m probably not the same person I was when I was with you. A lot has happened since then and I’ve done...a lot of horrible things.
lines.zh: : 可我该。我大概已经不是和你在一起时的那个人了。那之后发生了很多事，我也做了……很多可怕的事。

lines.en: : You can always change.
lines.zh: : 你随时都可以改变。

lines.en: : See, that’s the thing...I don’t {i}want{/i} to. And I have no idea what type of person I’d be if I {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你看，问题就在这儿……我{i}不想{/i}改。而且我根本不知道{i}改了{/i}之后自己会变成什么样的人。

lines.en: : I’ve become the worst parts of myself...I’ve accepted them. And getting rid of those traits would be more like me turning into a new person than turning over a new leaf.
lines.zh: : 我已经变成了自己最糟糕的那部分……而且我接受了它们。扔掉那些特质，与其说是改过自新，不如说是让我变成另一个人。

lines.en: : Then, I hope that bottomless pit of yours is wide enough for two.
lines.zh: : 那我希望你的那个无底洞够宽，能装下两个人。

lines.en: scene memorylane4
: Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : No matter what you’ve done or what you’ll {i}do,{/i} I’ll be right there with you.
lines.zh: : 不管你做过什么、将来{i}要做{/i}什么，我都会陪在你身边。

lines.en: : You chose a really stubborn person to spend so much time with way back when. This is the result of that.
lines.zh: : 很久以前你挑了个特别倔的人一起消磨那么多时间。这就是后果。

lines.en: : You’re too weak to function on your own. Plus, it’s not like I have to {i}agree{/i} with all of those “horrible things” you do, right?
lines.zh: : 你太软弱了，一个人根本活不下去。再说了，我又不是非得{i}认同{/i}你做的那些“可怕的事”，对吧？

lines.en: : You need someone to call you out on your shit — and who better than the girl who’s dealt with more of it than anyone?
lines.zh: : 你需要有人直截了当地指出你那些破事——还有谁比那个比你任何人都更了解这些的女孩更合适？

lines.en: : You’re not like this because you’re a bad person, you’re like this because you never learned how to be a good one.
lines.zh: : 你会变成这样不是因为你是个坏人，而是因为从来没人教过你怎么做个好人。

lines.en: : {i}It’s not your fault.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这不是你的错。{/i}

lines.en: scene memorylane5
: That...doesn’t make it okay.
lines.zh: : 那……也不能让这些事变得没问题。

lines.en: : Never said it did...just that I’ll always be your home when you have nowhere else to go.
lines.zh: : 我从没说过它没问题……我只是说，当你无处可去的时候，我永远是你的归宿。

lines.en: : I wish I remembered more of our past together.
lines.zh: : 真希望我能多记起一些我们一起走过的过去。

lines.en: : I don’t understand why I ever would have left you behind.
lines.zh: : 我不明白我当初怎么会抛下你。

lines.en: : You left me behind because you’re a selfish asshole who's never been able to grasp the fact that there are other people out there struggling as well.
lines.zh: : 你抛下我，是因为你是个自私的混蛋，从来都搞不明白这世上还有别人也在苦苦挣扎。

lines.en: : But you’re back now. And that’s what matters most.
lines.zh: : 但你现在回来了。这才是最重要的。

lines.en: : We’ll return your memories one way or another- even if I have to force them in myself.
lines.zh: : 我们总会把你的记忆还给你的——不管用什么办法，哪怕得由我亲手把它们塞回去。

lines.en: : Yeah? And how would you do that?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那你打算怎么做？

lines.en: : You don’t have any other plans for the rest of the day, do you?
lines.zh: : 你今天接下来没什么别的安排吧？

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Then...let's go for a walk-
lines.zh: : 那……我们去散步吧——

lines.en: scene somethinglikethis
One's grand flights, one's Sunday baths,
lines.zh: 一个人的高飞，一个人的周日沐浴，

lines.en: One's tootings at the weddings of the soul
lines.zh: 一个人在灵魂的婚礼上吹响号角，

lines.en: Occur as they occur. So bluish clouds
lines.zh: 该发生时就发生。于是泛蓝的云

lines.en: Occurred above the empty house and the leaves
lines.zh: 在空屋之上浮现，杜鹃花的叶子

lines.en: Of the rhododendrons rattled their gold,
lines.zh: 抖落一身金光，

lines.en: As if someone lived there. Such floods of white
lines.zh: 仿佛那里还有人住着。如此汹涌的白色

lines.en: Came bursting from the clouds. So the wind
lines.zh: 从云中迸发而出。于是风

lines.en: Threw its contorted strength around the sky.
lines.zh: 把扭曲的力气甩向整片天空。

lines.en: [[BREAK]
lines.zh: [[BREAK]

lines.en: Could you have said the bluejay suddenly
lines.zh: 你能否说那只蓝松鸦会突然

lines.en: Would swoop to earth? It is a wheel, the rays
lines.zh: 俯冲向大地？那是一个轮，太阳周围的光芒

lines.en: Around the sun. The wheel survives the myths.
lines.zh: 便是轮辐。轮子比神话活得更久。

lines.en: The fire eye in the clouds survives the gods.
lines.zh: 云中那只火眼比众神活得更久。

lines.en: To think of a dove with an eye of grenadine
lines.zh: 去想一只眼睛如石榴汁的鸽子，

lines.en: And pines that are cornets, so it occurs,
lines.zh: 以及那些化作短号的松树——它就那样发生，

lines.en: And a little island full of geese and stars:
lines.zh: 还有一座满是鹅与星辰的小岛：

lines.en: It may be the ignorant man, alone,
lines.zh: 也许唯有那个无知的人，独自一人，

lines.en: Has any chance to mate his life with life
lines.zh: 才有机会把自己的生命与生命相配，

lines.en: That is the sensual, pearly spouse, the life
lines.zh: 那感官的、珠贝般的新娘，那生命

lines.en: That is fluent in even the wintriest bronze.
lines.zh: 在最凛冽的青铜色里也依旧流畅。

scene specialsky
There is a disconnect between that which is real and that which is not — but that disconnection is not one to be perceived by man.
lines.zh: 真实之物与不真实之物之间有一道断裂——但这道断裂不是人所能感知的。

lines.en: It is visible to only those with the eyes of God and those who, in the moments of utmost unholiness, spill liquid sacrament from their pores and tongue.
lines.zh: 只有拥有上帝之眼的人，以及那些在最不神圣的时刻从毛孔与舌尖淌出液态圣餐的人，才看得见它。

lines.en: There is a trip to be traveled through unmapped parts of the world.
lines.zh: 有一趟旅程，要穿过这世界上尚未绘制地图的地方。

lines.en: You will see things that happened and didn’t.
lines.zh: 你会看见发生过的事，也会看见从未发生过的事。

lines.en: You will feel things you will never feel again.
lines.zh: 你会感受到此生再也不会感受到的东西。

scene memorylane7
A walk upon glass through a forest untouched brings us several steps closer to a dance with our mirrored selves.
lines.zh: 踏着玻璃走过一片无人涉足的森林，让我们离与镜中自我的共舞又近了几步。

lines.en: As my eyes connect with a conveyor belt of shadows and familiar unfamiliar faces, it is my legs that wind up moving while the world around me does not.
lines.zh: 当我的目光接上一条由阴影与既熟悉又陌生的面孔组成的传送带，最后动起来的却只有我的双腿，而我周围的世界静止不动。

lines.en: If I could break myself in two and reform with wings I would — but as I’ve never learned to fly, I must grapple with an unbearable truth and squeeze the life from out its body.
lines.zh: 如果我能把自己劈成两半、再长出翅膀重新拼合，我会这么做——但既然我从未学会飞，就只能与一个难以承受的真相搏斗，把生命从它体内挤出来。

lines.en: This is then and this is now.
lines.zh: 这是往昔，也是此刻。

lines.en: I remember how to make my heart move.
lines.zh: 我想起该怎么让心脏重新跳动。

lines.en: : Do you remember where we are?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我们在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Would it help if I gave you a hint?
lines.zh: : 要是我给你点提示，会有帮助吗？

lines.en: : I can’t really put my finger on it, but...
lines.zh: : 我也说不太清楚，不过……

lines.en: : I know I’ve been here before.
lines.zh: : 我知道我以前来过这里。

lines.en: scene memorylane8
: We built a secret base here out of stuff we picked from trash cans.
lines.zh: : 我们以前用从垃圾桶里捡来的东西，在这里搭了个秘密基地。

lines.en: : We filled it with snacks from my pantry and pretended we were an underground crime-fighting organization.
lines.zh: : 我们把我家食品柜里的零食搬来塞满，假装自己是一个地下的打击犯罪组织。

lines.en: : Any time we heard a noise, we’d hide behind trees and wait for some evildoer to move through the woods, but no one ever came.
lines.zh: : 每次一听到动静，我们就躲在树后面，等着哪个坏蛋穿过林子，可从来没人来过。

lines.en: : It was a huge waste of time looking back on things if you don’t count all of the comics we read here as “being productive” but holy shit were we always so excited to come.
lines.zh: : 现在回想起来那完全是浪费时间——除非你把我们在这儿看的那些漫画也算成“有在做正事”——但天哪，我们以前每次要来都兴奋得不行。

lines.en: : Things stopped being as exciting once Noriko found out about it and we began spending less and less time here as the days went by.
lines.zh: : 后来 Noriko 发现了这个地方，事情就没那么有意思了，日子一天天过去，我们在这儿待的时间也越来越少。

lines.en: : As you can see, there’s nothing left now...but this place was once really important to us.
lines.zh: : 你看，现在什么都不剩了……但这个地方曾经对我们真的很重要。

lines.en: scene memorylane9
: Ring any bells?
lines.zh: : 有点印象了吗？

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : How about this-
lines.zh: : 那这个呢——

lines.en: scene memorylane10
: We spent a lot of time in the woods when we were younger...but I never really realized it until I stopped going outside.
lines.zh: : 我们小时候在这片林子里待了很久……可我一直没真正意识到，直到我不再出门为止。

lines.en: : This was another spot we loved. Not far from here, there was a hidden path that led to a circle of abandoned gassho houses we’d sneak into to make out.
lines.zh: : 这是我们以前很喜欢的另一个地方。离这儿不远有一条隐蔽的小路，通向一圈废弃的合掌造老屋，我们会偷偷溜进去接吻。

lines.en: : It feels like just yesterday we were carving our names on that tree.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像昨天我们还在那棵树上刻下名字一样。

lines.en: : Sucks I wound up coming back to scribble yours out after you left me all alone.
lines.zh: : 可惜在你把我一个人丢下之后，我最后还是回来把你的名字划掉了。

lines.en: scene memorylane11
: Do you have your keys on you? Maybe we could make a new carving?
lines.zh: : 你带钥匙了吗？也许我们可以刻个新的？

lines.en: : You’re still interested in things like that?
lines.zh: : 你对这种事还有兴趣？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Don’t tell me you’re so dead inside that you’re against a little {i}vandalism{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 拜托。别告诉我你心里已经死到连一点点{i}涂鸦{/i}都反对了？

lines.en: My feet are cut deeper as the forest pulls us closer to its core.
lines.zh: 森林把我们拉向它的深处，我的脚被割得越来越深。

lines.en: And while images of the past break their legs trying to run through the four corners of my mind, I see nothing but an endless blur and {i}feel{/i} nothing but the blood soaking into my socks.
lines.zh: 往昔的画面拼命想跑遍我脑海的四角，却纷纷摔断了腿；我什么都看不见，只有一片无尽的模糊，什么都{i}感觉{/i}不到，只有渗进袜子里的血。

lines.en: The one sense that does not deceive me is my hearing as I can faintly make out the sound of a pocket knife being plunged into the flesh of an ancient tree.
lines.zh: 唯一没有欺骗我的感官是听觉——我隐约能辨认出折叠刀插进古树树身的声音。

lines.en: We’d peel away its skin and replace it with a dream — false hopes in the form of a relationship that would one day perish only to be resurrected by sheer coincidence years later.
lines.zh: 我们会剥掉它的皮，用一场梦来替换——那是以一段恋情为形状的虚妄希望，它总有一天会死去，却又在多年后因纯粹的巧合而复活。

lines.en: The rest begins to flow back in.
lines.zh: 其余的一切开始回流。

lines.en: How small her hands were back then.
lines.zh: 那时候她的手多小啊。

lines.en: The way her glasses would fog up when it got too hot.
lines.zh: 天一热，她的镜片就会蒙上一层雾。

lines.en: Her long, pink hair that would stick to my clothing and get me into trouble with-
lines.zh: 她那头长长的粉色头发会黏在我的衣服上，害我惹上麻烦——

lines.en: scene memorylane12
No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: Stop remembering.
lines.zh: 别再想了。

lines.en: : [[REDACTED]?
lines.zh: : [[REDACTED]？

lines.en: : Hmm...how come {i}we{/i} never carved our names into a tree? That would have been cute.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}我们{/i}怎么从来没在树上刻过名字呢？那样一定很可爱。

lines.en: : Hellooooo? Anybody home? You can’t just pretend you don’t see me. I know you do.
lines.zh: : 喂——喂——？有人在吗？你不能装作没看见我。我知道你看见了。

lines.en: : Hey, what’s going on? Are you remembering something?
lines.zh: : 喂，怎么了？你是想起什么了吗？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}obstinate as ever, I see. And Niki, wow! She’s so pretty now! I can’t help but feel a little jealous.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}还是这么倔，我明白了。还有 Niki，哇！她现在好漂亮！我忍不住有点嫉妒。

lines.en: : Are you two together again?
lines.zh: : 你们俩又在一起了？

lines.en: : Does she {i}fuck{/i} you like I did?
lines.zh: : 她{i}干你{/i}的时候像我当年那样吗？

lines.en: : Who’s better, me or her?
lines.zh: : 谁更厉害，是我还是她？

lines.en: : Be honest. I won’t get mad.
lines.zh: : 说实话。我不会生气的。

lines.en: : Hey. Talk to me. What’s-
lines.zh: : 喂。跟我说话啊。你在——

lines.en: : I remember this place.
lines.zh: : 我记得这个地方。

lines.en: scene memorylane13
: What? You do?
lines.zh: : 什么？你真的记得？

lines.en: : Yeah. We would come here...and there was a...circle of houses and...we would make out...
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们会来这里……然后有一圈……房子，然后……我们会接吻……

lines.en: : Yeah, but...you’re kind of just repeating what I said a couple minutes ago. Are you really sure you remember?
lines.zh: : 是，可是……你只是在重复我几分钟前说的话。你真的确定你想起来了吗？

lines.en: : Be honest. I won’t get mad.
lines.zh: : 说实话。我不会生气的。

lines.en: : More...
lines.zh: : 还要……

lines.en: : I need to see more...
lines.zh: : 我得看更多……

lines.en: : Take me somewhere else...
lines.zh: : 带我去别的地方……

lines.en: scene memorylane14
: Okay...
: We’ll go on an all-inclusive tour down memory lane...
lines.zh: : 我们来一趟记忆小径的全包之旅……

lines.en: : From where it all began...
lines.zh: : 从一切开始的地方……

scene memorylane15
: To where it all ended.
lines.zh: : 到一切结束的地方。

lines.en: : Where...
lines.zh: : 这是……

lines.en: : Where are we?...
lines.zh: : 我们在哪儿？……

lines.en: : I think it’s better if you remember this one without any help.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个地方最好让你自己想起来，别给提示。

lines.en: : This place had a much more profound impact on you than it did on me, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟这个地方对你的影响要比对我深得多。

lines.en: Before this, there were other places.
lines.zh: 在这之前，还有别的地方。

lines.en: A convenience store where we’d stop on the way to school.
lines.zh: 一家我们上学路上会顺路进去的便利店。

lines.en: An old bus stop where we’d wait for over an hour sometimes for a ride into the urban district.
lines.zh: 一个旧公交站，我们有时要等上一个多小时，才搭上车进城。

lines.en: An Italian restaurant we never went inside, but always talked about how it would be nice to be able to eat there one day.
lines.zh: 一家我们从没进去过的意大利餐厅，却总在说要是有一天能在那儿吃一顿该多好。

lines.en: A softball field.
lines.zh: 一片垒球场。

lines.en: A community pool.
lines.zh: 一个社区泳池。

lines.en: The yard of an old house where a dog used to live.
lines.zh: 一所老房子的院子，那里以前住过一条狗。

lines.en: It’s gone now and a new one has taken its place.
lines.zh: 它现在不在了，取而代之的是另一条。

lines.en: Each of these locations spurred something inside of me to begin moving again. And slowly but surely, the faded traces of what {i}should{/i} be mine have opened up to the idea of coming home.
lines.zh: 这些地方每一个都在我体内推动了什么，让它重新开始活动。而缓慢却坚定地，那些本{i}该{/i}属于我的褪色痕迹，开始接受“回家”这个念头。

lines.en: So why has that all come screeching to a halt at the end of the tour?
lines.zh: 那么，为什么这一切在旅程的终点戛然而止？

lines.en: Why am I numb again {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: 为什么我{i}现在{/i}又麻木了？

lines.en: Was I just caught up in the moment earlier?...Piggybacking off of Niki’s nostalgia because I’m so desperate for my own?
lines.zh: 刚才我只是被气氛带着走了吗？……因为太渴望拥有自己的回忆，就借着 Niki 的怀旧情绪蹭了上去？

lines.en: scene memorylane16
Or am I just suppressing something?
lines.zh: 还是说，我只是压抑着什么？

lines.en: : You jumped.
lines.zh: : 你从那里跳了下去。

lines.en: : Do you remember?
lines.zh: : 你还记得吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : Take as much time as you need.
lines.zh: : 你想花多久就花多久。

lines.en: : This is the hardest part of the trip after all. And I’ve already told you-
lines.zh: : 这毕竟是这趟旅程最难的一段。而且我已经说过了——

lines.en: : I’ll return your memories even if I have to force them back in myself.
lines.zh: : 我会把你的记忆还给你，哪怕得由我亲手把它们塞回去。

: This...
lines.zh: : 这里……

lines.en: : This is where it happened...
lines.zh: : 就是在这里发生的……

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : This is where your world was ripped away from you.
lines.zh: : 就是在这里，你的世界被从你身上撕走了。

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene everythingg
scene memorylane24
: You can’t only open yourself up to the good memories, you have to let the bad ones in too.
lines.zh: : 你不能只向好的记忆敞开，也得让坏的那些进来。

lines.en: : You’ll never move on if you just keep ignoring the things that make you hurt. You have to {i}work{/i} if you ever want to get better. Only then will you be able to look back on the past without breaking into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 要是一直无视那些让你痛苦的东西，你永远走不出去。你得{i}下功夫{/i}，才有可能好起来。只有到那时，你回望过去才不会碎成一百万片。

lines.en: : But I promise you, and I mean this with {i}all{/i} of my heart, I will be there {i}every...single...step{/i} of the way.
lines.zh: : 但我向你保证——我是{i}全心全意{/i}地说这句话——我会陪着你走过{i}每……一……步{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re not alone...
lines.zh: : 你不是一个人……

lines.en: : {i}Look at me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看着我。{/i}

lines.en: scene memorylane25
: {i}You’re not alone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不是一个人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay?{/i}
: No matter how horrible you become...or how much work it takes to get you through a single day without feeling sorry for yourself...
lines.zh: : 不管你变得多糟糕……也不管要费多大力气才能让你撑过一天而不自怨自艾……

lines.en: : I will be here. I’ve {i}always{/i} been here.
lines.zh: : 我都会在这里。我{i}一直{/i}都在这里。

lines.en: : You’re my best friend in the whole entire world...and I am so...{i}so{/i} sorry you had to go through what you did...
lines.zh: : 你是我在这整个世界最好的朋友……而我真的……{i}真的{/i}很抱歉，你不得不经历那些事……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : I don’t want to watch you suffer anymore...
lines.zh: : 我不想再看着你受苦了……

lines.en: : I want my friend back...
lines.zh: : 我想要我的朋友回来……

lines.en: : Will you please stop running? Both literally {i}and{/i} figuratively?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再逃了？不管是字面意义上的，{i}还{/i}是比喻意义上的？

lines.en: : Please?...
lines.zh: : 求你了？……

lines.en: : You really won’t leave?
lines.zh: : 你真的不会走吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. Never.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。永远不会。

lines.en: : No matter what I become?
lines.zh: : 不管我变成什么样？

lines.en: scene memorylane26
: No matter what you become.
lines.zh: : 不管你变成什么样。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Because I’m a fucking idiot.
lines.zh: : 因为我就是个天杀的蠢货。

lines.en: : But I’m {i}your{/i} fucking idiot. And you’re my big, melancholic doofus.
lines.zh: : 但我是{i}你{/i}天杀的蠢货。而你是我的那个又大只又忧郁的傻瓜。

lines.en: : So let’s go be stupid together...far away from the places that make us hurt.
lines.zh: : 所以，我们一起去犯傻吧……离那些让我们痛苦的地方远远的。

lines.en: : Let’s go somewhere quiet...and comfortable...
lines.zh: : 我们去找个安静的……舒服的地方……

lines.en: : {i}Let’s go home, Akira...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们回家吧，Akira……{/i}

lines.en: scene black
Akira...
lines.zh: Akira……

lines.en: That’s...my name.
lines.zh: 那是……我的名字。

lines.en: My name is Akira.
lines.zh: 我的名字是 Akira。

lines.en: I’m a good boy.
lines.zh: 我是个好孩子。
